headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: HAM (4)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Japanese Grand Prix from pole position, 19.4s ahead of Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Guanyu Zhou made the biggest climb, from P19 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised SAR (5 second time penalty), PER (5 second time penalty) and PER (5 second time penalty).
There were 43 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 177 points over Sergio Perez.
